records.source: So I was at Willy's other day and he showed me {1} {2} you brought in.#$e#I cooked it up for dinner with some lemon and a side of rice pilaf. Pretty good!$h
records.translation: 前幾天我去威利的店，他拿你送來的{1}{2}給我看。#$e#我加了些檸檬做成晚餐，配上香料飯。相當不錯！$h

records.source: Ahoy... you know that {2} you sold me the other day? Well, I sizzled it up in me cabin last night...#$b#T'was the mealiest fish I've ever set me gums on...$s
records.translation: 喂……還記得前幾天賣給我的{2}嗎？昨晚我在船艙裡把它煎了……#$b#那是我這輩子吃過肉質最鬆散的魚……$s

records.source: Ahoy! Remember that {2} you brought in the other day? Well, I sizzled it up in me cabin last night...#$b#T'was the finest fish I've had since I was a wee lad!$h
records.translation: 喂！還記得前幾天送來的{2}嗎？昨晚我在船艙裡把它煎了……#$b#那是我從小到大吃過最棒的魚！$h

records.source: Eww... What are you doing?$s
records.translation: 噁……你在做什麼？$s

records.source: Um... Why are you digging in the trash?$s
records.translation: 呃……你為什麼在翻垃圾？$s

records.source: Hey, Stop that! ...Yuck!$s
records.translation: 嘿，住手！……真噁心！$s

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your {1} upgrade the day after tomorrow. I always take festivals off.$h
records.translation: 好，我後天開始進行{1}升級。我在節慶時一律休假。$h

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your {1} upgrade first thing tomorrow morning!$h
records.translation: 好，我明天一早就開始進行{1}升級！$h

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your new {0} the day after tomorrow. I always take festivals off.$h
records.translation: 好，我後天開始建造你的新{0}。我在節慶時一律休假。$h

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your new {0} first thing tomorrow morning!$h
records.translation: 好，我明天一早就開始建造你的新{0}！$h

records.source: This {0} is pre-fabricated, so there's no construction time! Convenient, isn't it?$h
records.translation: 這個{0}是預製的，所以不用等待施工！很方便，對吧？$h

records.source: Excellent! We'll get our workers on it tonight. It should be ready for you by tomorrow.
records.translation: 太好了！今晚我們就會派工人處理。明天應該能為你準備好。

records.source: Ah, our favorite customer... I have exciting news for you! Joja headquarters has approved the construction of a new Joja 'entertainment opportunity' to replace the nearby Joja Warehouse. We just need an investor willing to support our vision! So, naturally, I turn to you... our most devoted and generous Joja member.#$b#$q -1 -1#We could make this happen for a small investment of... *cough*... 500,000g...$h#$r -1 -1 Yes#Yes#$r -1 -1 No#No
records.translation: 啊，我們最喜愛的顧客……有個令人興奮的消息！Joja 總部已批准興建全新的 Joja「娛樂機會」，取代附近的 Joja 倉庫。我們只需要一位願意支持這份願景的投資人！所以，自然而然就想到了你……我們最忠誠、最慷慨的 Joja 會員。#$b#$q -1 -1#只需一筆小額投資……*咳嗽*……500,000g……$h#$r -1 -1 Yes#是#$r -1 -1 No#否

records.source: Half a mil...!$2#$b#*Ahem*... I mean... Excellent! Our Joja Construction Team will begin work on the new building tonight! Thank you for supporting our work.
records.translation: 五十萬……！$2#$b#*清喉嚨*……我是說……太好了！Joja 施工團隊今晚就會開始興建新大樓！感謝你支持我們的工作。

records.source: Ah! My favorite customer... Unfortunately I have no more community development projects available at the moment.
records.translation: 啊！我最喜愛的顧客……很遺憾，目前已經沒有其他社區發展專案了。

records.source: Are you okay? I found you washed up on the shore, lad.$s^Are you okay? I found you washed up on the shore, miss.$s#$b#You really had me worried... I thought you were a goner! Be a little more careful out there...$s#$b#The island can be a dangerous place.
records.translation: 你還好嗎？我發現你被沖上岸了，小夥子。$s^你還好嗎？我發現你被沖上岸了，小姐。$s#$b#你真的讓我很擔心……我還以為你沒救了！在外面小心一點……$s#$b#這座島可能很危險。

records.source: It seems like you're going to live.$u#$b#My bird-friends spotted you and told me you were in danger, so I dragged you all the way down here.$s#$b#Please be safe out there. I don't want to be sad anymore...$s
records.translation: 看來你能活下來。$u#$b#我的鳥朋友發現了你，告訴我你有危險，所以我一路把你拖到這裡。$s#$b#在外面請注意安全。我不想再難過了……$s

records.source: I never thought I'd see a new face on this island, dear. But I'm glad you're here!
records.translation: 親愛的，從沒想過會在這座島上見到新面孔。不過很高興你來了！

records.source: It's rumored that long ago, a great civilization of dwarves lived on this very island.#$e#Have you been inside the volcano? It's filled with the ruins of their strange machines...
records.translation: 傳說很久以前，這座島上住著偉大的矮人文明。#$e#你進過火山嗎？裡面到處是他們奇特機器的遺跡……

records.source: If you're ever feeling queasy in the stomach, a bite of ginger does wonders, dear...
records.translation: 親愛的，如果胃裡感到不舒服，吃一口薑會有奇效……

records.source: Have you been to the secret shrine in the jungle? The flowers there smell lovely... It's one of my favorite spots on the island.$h
records.translation: 你去過叢林裡的祕密神龕嗎？那裡的花香非常美妙……是我在島上最喜歡的地方之一。$h

records.source: Every morning for breakfast, I have a bowl of poi and a glass of freshly squeezed mango juice. It keeps me young!
records.translation: 每天早餐，我都會吃一碗波伊芋泥，再喝一杯鮮榨芒果汁。這讓我保持年輕！

records.source: I walk the beach every day to see if anything new has washed ashore. There's a lot floating around out there!
records.translation: 我每天都會沿著海灘散步，看看有沒有新東西被沖上岸。外面海上漂著很多東西！

records.source: My hut may be small, but it's more than enough for what I need. And best of all, I built it myself.
records.translation: 我的小屋也許不大，但足以滿足所有需要。最棒的是，這是我親手建造的。

records.source: *sigh*... To live in a world of endless potential, we can never know if we've made the right choices.$s#$b#Sorry to trouble you, my dear. I sometimes get carried away by thoughts...
records.translation: *嘆氣*……生活在充滿無限可能的世界裡，我們永遠無法知道自己是否做了正確的選擇。$s#$b#親愛的，抱歉打擾你。有時我會沉浸在思緒裡……

records.source: Fruit, fish, and foraged food... It's a good diet! I feel as healthy as ever.
records.translation: 水果、魚和採集來的食物……這是很好的飲食！我覺得自己一如既往地健康。

records.source: The weather is warm and lovely year round, my dear... it feels perfect for me bones...
records.translation: 親愛的，這裡全年氣候溫暖宜人……對我這副老骨頭再合適不過……

records.source: Have you seen the little banana altar in the jungle? If I had a banana I'd set it there and see what happens... heh heh...$h
records.translation: 你看到叢林裡的香蕉小祭壇了嗎？如果有根香蕉，我會放上去看看會發生什麼……嘿嘿……$h

records.source: Hello, dear... you look healthy and in good spirits today!$h
records.translation: 你好，親愛的……你今天看起來健康又有精神！$h

records.source: I've been here so long, I can't even hear the ocean anymore...
records.translation: 我在這裡待得太久，甚至已經聽不見海洋了……

records.source: It's a full moon, tonight... Whether your fortune be good or bad, be on the alert, my dear... The spirits are restless.
records.translation: 今晚是滿月……無論運勢是好是壞，都要保持警覺，親愛的……靈魂躁動不安。

records.source: Oh, no no no... I don't need any gifts, my dear. You keep it.
records.translation: 喔，不、不、不……親愛的，我不需要任何禮物。你自己留著吧。

records.source: My research suggests that a species of frog once lived on this island. They would've inhabited a dark, damp area, with lots of vegetation...
records.translation: 我的研究顯示，曾有一種青蛙生活在這座島上。牠們應該棲息在陰暗潮溼、植被繁茂的區域……

records.source: Long ago, a rare species of cave-bat made their home here. The evidence suggests they were adapted to tolerate intense heat. Interesting, huh?
records.translation: 很久以前，一種稀有的洞穴蝙蝠在這裡棲息。證據顯示，牠們已適應耐受極端高溫。很有意思，對吧？

records.source: Hmm... My nose is telling me that snake spines might be found in the western region of the island.
records.translation: 嗯……我的鼻子告訴我，島嶼西部也許能找到蛇脊椎。

records.source: If you see something wiggling in the dirt, make sure to excavate it. You never know what might be under there!
records.translation: 如果看到泥土裡有東西在扭動，一定要把它挖出來。誰也不知道下面藏著什麼！

records.source: Before I got stuck in that cave, I was exploring the little gully nearby. The stones there are full of fossils! If I were you, I'd be breaking them open to look for bones.
records.translation: 困在那個洞穴前，我正在探索附近的小山溝。那裡的石頭滿是化石！如果是我，就會敲開它們尋找骨頭。

records.source: You know, I bet if you did some panning, you could find some interesting stuff in the nearby river.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我敢說只要在附近河流淘洗，就能找到一些有趣的東西。

records.source: You know, there's some great fishing on this island. From what I know, many of the fish enjoy nibbling on ancient bones...
records.translation: 你知道嗎，這座島很適合釣魚。據我所知，許多魚都喜歡啃食古老的骨頭……

records.source: Have you found any golden coconuts on the island? It's rumored that many interesting things can be found inside of them...
records.translation: 你在島上找到金色椰子了嗎？傳說裡面能發現許多有趣的東西……

records.source: Wow... Look at that view.
records.translation: 哇……看看那片景色。

records.source: You know, @... I've been mayor of Pelican Town for a long time.#$b#People have come and gone. We've lived through times of hardship, and times of plenty.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，@……我當鵜鶘鎮鎮長已經很久了。#$b#人們來來去去。我們經歷過艱難歲月，也享受過富足時光。

records.source: But I have to say, in all the years I've been mayor, nothing has made me so proud as seeing %farm Farm blossom under your care.$h#$b#You've taken the farm beyond the wildest dreams of your Grandfather.#$b#And in the process, you've changed the valley forever.
records.translation: 但不得不說，在我擔任鎮長的所有歲月裡，沒有什麼比看著%farm農場在你的照料下蓬勃發展更令我驕傲。$h#$b#你讓農場的成就遠遠超越了祖父最狂野的夢想。#$b#在這個過程中，你也永遠改變了山谷。

records.source: You might not realize it, but I care a lot about this town, @.#$b#%year years ago, I was deeply worried about the future of the valley.$s#$b#But now, I feel completely at ease.#$b#Who knew a humble farmer moving to town would change everything?$h#$b#...Thank you.
records.translation: 你也許沒有察覺，但我非常在乎這個鎮，@。#$b#%year年前，我深深擔憂山谷的未來。$s#$b#但現在，我完全放心了。#$b#誰能想到，一位樸實的農夫搬來鎮上，竟會改變一切？$h#$b#……謝謝你。

records.source: Ah, @... My favorite Joja member.
records.translation: 啊，@……我最喜愛的 Joja 會員。

records.source: You know, when I was first assigned to this location over %year years ago, I considered it a step back in my career.#$b#What self-respecting Joja Manager would want to preside over a tiny, backwater location like Pelican Town?$h
records.translation: 你知道嗎，%year多年前我剛被派到這個地點時，認為那是職涯上的倒退。#$b#哪位有自尊的 Joja 經理會想管理鵜鶘鎮這種偏僻的小地方？$h

records.source: But I have to say, this valley has really grown on me, over the years.#$b#Working here has opened my eyes to a different way of life. It's hard to say this, but... It's been... a humbling experience.
records.translation: 但不得不說，多年來我真的漸漸喜歡上了這座山谷。#$b#在這裡工作讓我看見不同的生活方式。這很難說出口，但……這是一次……讓人學會謙卑的經歷。

records.source: I just want to say, @... I appreciate all the hard work you've done for Joja Co.#$b#Our strength comes from our members, and you've shown exemplary drive and ingenuity. It makes me proud to work for the company.$h
records.translation: 我只想說，@……感謝你為 Joja 公司付出的所有努力。#$b#我們的力量來自會員，而你展現了堪稱典範的幹勁與才智。能為公司工作，令我感到驕傲。$h

records.source: Hey, @.
It's so beautiful up here...
records.translation: 這裡真美……

records.source: Great view, huh?
records.translation: 景色很棒，對吧？

records.source: I was just thinking about the last %year years...
records.translation: 我剛才在回想過去%year年……

records.source: We've been through a lot together, haven't we?$h
records.translation: 我們一起經歷了很多，對吧？$h

records.source: ...But look how far we've come.
records.translation: ……但看看我們已經走了多遠。

records.source: I've finally discovered who I want to be... and I feel certain about the future."/pause 500/speak Alex "I don't think I would've gotten here without you, @."
records.translation: 我終於發現自己想成為怎樣的人……也對未來充滿信心。"/pause 500/speak Alex "如果沒有你，我想自己不會走到這裡，@。"

records.source: Before I met you, I spent most of my time turned away from reality... because I thought I'd never find happiness.#$b#...but you've shown me that the world isn't such a dark place, after all.$h"/faceDirection Sebastian 3/pause 500/speak Sebastian "...That's one of the reasons I love you..."
records.translation: 遇見你以前，我大多數時間都背對現實……因為我以為自己永遠找不到幸福。#$b#……但你讓我明白，這個世界終究沒有那麼黑暗。$h"/faceDirection Sebastian 3/pause 500/speak Sebastian "……這就是我愛你的原因之一……"

records.source: I feel like I've changed a lot from when we first met... you know?#$b#...you might call it 'maturity'... hehe.$10#$b#But I'm at a place, now, where I'm actually really excited about our future together...$l#$b#Even if that means just doing normal stuff, like... uh... buying groceries and changing diapers... hah...$10
records.translation: 我覺得自己和初次見面時相比改變了很多……你懂吧？#$b#……也許可以稱之為「成熟」……嘿嘿。$10#$b#不過現在，我真的非常期待我們共同的未來……$l#$b#即使那只代表做些平凡的事，像是……呃……買日用品和換尿布……哈……$10

records.source: If I hadn't met you, @... I might not even be here right now.#$b#Which would be a shame, because the bird-watching up here is phenomenal!$h"/emote farmer 16/pause 1000/speak Shane "Heh... I... I tend to joke a lot, because...well...$s#$b#I guess keeping things light-hearted makes it so I don't have to open up and make myself vulnerable."/emote Shane 28/speak Shane "But every season that goes by, with you, I get a little more comfortable with myself.#$b#Uh.. I guess what I want to say is...#$b#I have no regrets marrying you!$h"
records.translation: 如果沒有遇見你，@……我現在甚至可能已經不在這裡。#$b#那會很可惜，因為這裡的賞鳥體驗好得不得了！$h"/emote farmer 16/pause 1000/speak Shane "嘿……我……我常常開玩笑，因為……怎麼說呢……$s#$b#我想，保持輕鬆就不必敞開心扉，暴露脆弱的一面。"/emote Shane 28/speak Shane "但和你共度的每個季節，都讓我更能自在地面對自己。#$b#呃……我想說的是……#$b#和你結婚，我從不後悔！$h"

records.source: Heh... it just dawned on me...$h#$b#We've reached the summit, but not just physically... metaphorically as well.#$b#How poetic!$l
records.translation: 嘿……我剛剛突然想到……$h#$b#我們抵達了頂峰，但不只是身體上……也有象徵意義。#$b#多麼詩意！$l

records.source: When I'm next to you, I'm not even scared of falling off this cliff and dashing onto the sharp rocks below...$l"/jump Harvey/shake Harvey 1000/pause 1000/speak Harvey "...$8#$b#I... I love and admire you very much, @...$l"
records.translation: 只要在你身邊，我甚至不怕從這座懸崖墜落，摔在下方尖銳的岩石上……$l"/jump Harvey/shake Harvey 1000/pause 1000/speak Harvey "……$8#$b#我……我非常愛你，也非常敬佩你，@……$l"

records.source: Standing here, looking out on the horizon... I get a feeling of endless possibility.#$b#I'm just happy I get to explore this world, with you by my side...$l
records.translation: 站在這裡眺望地平線……我感受到無限的可能。#$b#能有你陪在身邊，一起探索這個世界，我真的很開心……$l

records.source: This is a special moment...#$b#I've always known I would be standing here with you, someday. I've always felt it in my heart.#$b#Now, it's all come true."/pause 500/speak Emily "The world is a mysterious and special place...$l"
records.translation: 這是特別的一刻……#$b#我一直知道，有一天會和你一起站在這裡。內心始終有這種感覺。#$b#現在，一切都成真了。"/pause 500/speak Emily "世界是一個神祕而特別的地方……$l"

records.source: *giggle*... $h"/faceDirection farmer 1 true/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/speak Haley "Oh, it's just that...#$b#As a little girl, I always dreamed that one day, I would climb to the summit with my true love, and share a kiss.$l"
records.translation: *咯咯笑*……$h"/faceDirection farmer 1 true/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/speak Haley "喔，只是因為……#$b#小時候我總是夢想，有一天能和真愛一起登上頂峰，分享一個吻。$l"

records.source: I think we've both found what we were looking for in this place.#$b#I wouldn't want to be anywhere else, but here with you.$l
records.translation: 我想我們都在這裡找到了自己追尋的東西。#$b#除了在這裡陪著你，我哪裡也不想去。$l

records.source: We have a beautiful home and a thriving family... it's all I've ever dreamed of, and more.$l
records.translation: 我們有美麗的家和興旺的家庭……這是我夢寐以求的一切，甚至更多。$l

records.source: You've really accomplished a lot since you moved here, @. It's incredible."/pause 300/faceDirection Maru 3/pause 400/speak Maru "I think it's safe to say that you were meant to be a farmer!$h"
records.translation: 搬來這裡後，你真的完成了許多成就，@。太不可思議了。"/pause 300/faceDirection Maru 3/pause 400/speak Maru "可以肯定地說，你天生就該當農夫！$h"

records.source: It's been a long road...
records.translation: 這是一段漫長的旅程……

records.source: You challenged yourself to reach the summit
records.translation: 你挑戰自我，抵達了頂峰

records.source: What an accomplishment!
records.translation: 多麼了不起的成就！

records.source: We've been watching every step of the way
records.translation: 我們一路見證了你的每一步

records.source: And you've made us very proud!
records.translation: 而你讓我們無比驕傲！
